infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GoodRunss uses your location to find nearby basketball courts, tennis courts, and trainers. This allows you to see facilities on the map relative to your position.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: GoodRunss uses your location to notify you when you are near active courts or facilities you've favorited.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: To set your profile picture and report court conditions, GoodRunss needs access to your camera. For example, you can take a photo of a court to show others it is busy.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: GoodRunss accesses your photo library to let you upload profile pictures and share photos of court conditions.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: GoodRunss uses the microphone for voice messages in chat.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: GoodRunss reads your workout data to visualize your fitness trends and activity history.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: GoodRunss saves your court sessions to Apple Health.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow GoodRunss to use your location to show nearby trainers, courts, and studios.

plugins.photosPermission: GoodRunss needs access to your photos to upload profile pictures and venue photos.
plugins.cameraPermission: GoodRunss needs camera access so you can take a profile picture or share a photo of a court condition.
